<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target product (the Friedel‑Crafts acylation product), yields the three precursors listed earlier. I will construct the product SMILES as COc1ccnc(c1)C(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N and search the template catalog for templates that break a halide (C‑Cl) bond and form a C‑C bond, which matches a Friedel‑Crafts acylation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1ccnc(c1)C(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
